description: This file defines the ManufacturerService interface for managing manufacturers within the shopizer project. It declares methods for listing manufacturers by store and language, saving/updating manufacturers, adding descriptions, counting attached products, deleting manufacturers, and listing by categories.

classes.name: ManufacturerService
classes.description: Interface defining service methods for manufacturer management in the shopizer platform.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with a specific store and optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a manufacturer entity.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a manufacturer.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the number of products attached to a manufacturer.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products in specific categories within a store.
